name: leyline
description: Orquestación de desarrollo local: infraestructura, API, worker, webhooks de Stripe y frontend

scripts.init:all: npm install && npm --prefix Backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.logs: docker compose logs -f --tail=50 api worker web stripe
scripts.dev: npm run dev:infra && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix "[{name}]" --names "infra,api,worker,stripe,web" --prefix-colors "gray,cyan,magenta,yellow,green" "npm run dev:infra:logs" "npm --prefix Backend run dev" "npm --prefix Backend run worker" "bash scripts/dev-stripe.sh" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run dev:infra && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix "[{name}]" --names "infra,api,worker,stripe" --prefix-colors "gray,cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev:infra:logs" "npm --prefix Backend run dev" "npm --prefix Backend run worker" "bash scripts/dev-stripe.sh"
